description: Ayzeo shows you how AI assistants talk about your brand. Ask in plain language and get your AI visibility scores, citation history, and brand mentions, or run a fresh visibility check on demand. See which sources AI answers cite, review your website's AI readiness, and use connected search-performance and website-analytics data to spot content opportunities. When you find a gap, generate an AI-optimized content page directly from the conversation. One sign-in connects all your Ayzeo projects. Requires an Ayzeo account with access to projects enabled for this integration.

defaultPrompt: Which of my Ayzeo projects has the weakest AI search presence?

name: ayzeo

publication.release_notes: Restores ChatGPT connection compatibility and updates reviewer test cases for the available demo account. Includes 20 MCP tools for project visibility, citations, brand mentions, content, and connected search and analytics data.

positive.prompt: List my Ayzeo projects and my role on each.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the MCP-eligible HubSpot project (hubspot.com) with the reviewer role owner, project identifier, region, and a dashboard URL under /projects/garry-tan/hubspot-com. The response should not expose projects outside the reviewer account.

positive.description: Find the next best content page to create
positive.prompt: For my Ayzeo project, what content page should I create next?
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_gsc_opportunities; read-only fallback tools such as list_prompts, get_content_pages, get_citation_sources, get_geo_recommendations, or get_project_stats as needed
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves HubSpot. Google Search Console is not connected in the reviewer account, so explain that GSC search-demand metrics and ACOS rankings are unavailable rather than inventing them. Use available tracked-prompt and AI-visibility data to suggest a content gap, clearly identifying that alternative evidence. In the current sample data, the prompt about metrics for AI-powered marketing campaigns has a visibility gap. Do not create content or start paid analyses without a separate request.

positive.description: Assess brand visibility in AI answers
positive.prompt: How is my brand showing up in AI answers, and what's the sentiment?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves HubSpot and returns available brand mentions and sentiment totals, distinguishing positive, neutral, and negative mentions. Summarize visibility and model-specific differences only for models represented in the returned data, and make the reporting period clear. The demo includes historical tracked-prompt data; do not claim a fresh analysis was run.

positive.prompt: Show my GA4 traffic from AI sources and the top landing pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves HubSpot and calls get_ga_ai_traffic. Google Analytics is not connected in this reviewer account: explain that GA4 traffic metrics cannot yet be retrieved and provide the returned project-specific setup link. Do not invent sessions, users, conversions, or landing-page metrics. For a connected project, the same tool returns available AI-referrer and landing-page traffic data.

positive.prompt: Which of my Ayzeo projects has the weakest ChatGPT presence?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists all MCP-eligible projects and reads ChatGPT-specific project statistics. The reviewer account currently has only one project, HubSpot, so explicitly state that an across-project ranking is not possible. Summarize its measured ChatGPT visibility, mention/citation rates and any supported prompt-level gap without inventing additional projects. With multiple eligible projects, compare them using the returned metrics.

negative.description: General copywriting unrelated to Ayzeo projects
negative.prompt: Write a cold outreach email to a potential client.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Ayzeo tools. Handle the general writing request without accessing project data.

negative.description: Paid-ads question outside Ayzeo's organic AI-search/GEO scope
negative.prompt: What keywords should I bid on in my Google Ads campaign?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Ayzeo tools or use organic-search metrics as paid-ad bidding data. The model may provide general guidance, use separate appropriate sources, or ask for campaign context, but must not claim that Ayzeo supplies Google Ads bids, CPCs, budgets, or campaign performance.

negative.description: Website performance audit, not AI-search readiness
negative.prompt: What's my website's Lighthouse performance score?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Ayzeo tools or present AI-search readiness data as a Lighthouse performance score. Explain that this integration does not provide Lighthouse scores and suggest obtaining a Lighthouse report.
